PXL DUB FOR MACOS

DOWNLOAD AU + VST3 ↓

Apple Silicon · macOS 12+ · Stereo instrument

Developer ID signed · Apple notarized.

Installation & playing

Unzip the download. Copy whole .component bundles from Components to ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/Components/ and .vst3 bundles from VST3 to ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/. Back up existing copies before replacing them, then restart and rescan your DAW. Load PXL Dub as an instrument and start the transport. Turn Host Sync off to play with its internal clock.

The browser version uses its own transport. It does not connect to your DAW or take an external sidechain input.
